_comment: SYNTHETIC fixture - a GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{n} response. Never captured from a real repository. Consumed by nothing today; see ../../overview.md.

_quirks.assignees: present as [] here, unlike the search endpoint which omits the key - the inconsistency the mapper absorbs.
_quirks.labels: returned as objects; other endpoints return bare strings, which mapGithubLabelNames also accepts.
_quirks.body: Markdown, and may be null on a body-less issue - the detail shape adds this field, which no list_* tool returns.

title: Crash on glucose import
body:
## Steps to reproduce

1. Open the import screen
2. Select a CSV exported before 2026-01
3. Confirm

**Expected:** rows are imported.
**Actual:** the app closes without a message.
